|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Block 7)]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-14-front-master.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Block 7)]] (original, release sheet of 3 June 2011); [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); '''this page''' (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011; the slip and the Players Committee card image print it)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011), page 3, slip 14 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “''If opponent went first this game, retrieve 1 Force when you play this Interrupt.'' Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. OR Activate up to 2 Force. OR ▲ [[Control]]. OR Until end of turn, battle destiny draws may not be modified or canceled (unless being redrawn).” The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 35)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=35, page 35. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=35 Internet Archive]</ref> prints this text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 (this page), and the current text. The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) spells “just drwn destiny” (typo as published) and writes “retrieve 1 force” and “Or ▲ Control”. PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1273_14">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11]; the same text in the VMasterType list) (Internet Archive)</ref>: “''If opponent went first this game, retrieve 1 force when you play this Interrupt.'' Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drwn destiny. OR Activate up to 2 Force. Or ▲ [[Control]]. OR Until end of turn, battle destiny draws may not be modified or canceled (unless being redrawn).” The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-adarktimefortherebellion-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]) again, word for word: “''If opponent went first this game, retrieve 1 Force when you play this Interrupt.'' Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. OR Activate up to 2 Force. OR ▲ [[Control]]. OR Until end of turn, battle destiny draws may not be modified or canceled (unless being redrawn).” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034727/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 35)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]) again, word for word: “''If opponent went first this game, retrieve 1 Force when you play this Interrupt.'' Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. OR Activate up to 2 Force. OR ▲ [[Control]]. OR Until end of turn, battle destiny draws may not be modified or canceled (unless being redrawn).” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-14-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image. The release-sheet slip and the PC card image print the caption “•A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V)”; the Master List slip prints it without the dot.
